reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduledAmount and reuses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules, the same tolerance the matching code uses.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the approximate-amount tolerance stays in getApproxNumberThreshold and the worst-case rule in getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The rule change lands in shared/schedules.ts where the worst-case rule already lived; callers only pass their operator.

scope.why: Touches only the helper, its tests and the call sites that must now pass the operator; form conversions in useScheduleEdit are rightly left alone.

maintainability.why: Clean single definition; inserting the operator as a positional parameter before inverse makes calls like (amount, null, true) slightly awkward and every caller must remember to pass the op.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount (using shared/rules getApproxNumberThreshold), called by every expected-amount path: preview transactions, posting, updateActions, schedule templates, forecast, API and the desktop views
